reasons: Detection is correct: Article XII runs solely in favour of Licensor and Article XIII(a) expressly disclaims all Licensor liability for infringement claims, so a Vendor/Licensor indemnity is genuinely missing — the rule's walk-away scenario, justifying critical severity.

The inserted paragraph (b) tracks the playbook model language closely (IP infringement/misappropriation, breach of law, Licensor-caused unauthorised access, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) and adds the required notice/control/cooperation mechanics, and it is placed inside the existing indemnity Article, which is the correct location.

Narrowing the Licensee indemnity to Licensee-provided content and Licensee's breach of applicable law, and limiting it to third-party claims, matches the preferred position; the high changed-character ratio on p0129 is expected because the original triggers ('conduct of Licensee's business', 'breach of any term') must be replaced to reach the playbook position.

The express carve-out from Article XIII is substantively necessary — without it the new indemnity would be nullified by the infringement exclusion and the one-half cap — and the comment appropriately offers the 3x annual fees / customary exclusions fallback.

Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, correctly cites the playbook position and the offending provisions; minor extra narrowing (removal of Licensor's affiliates/officers as indemnitees) is directionally consistent and immaterial.
